cases.description: Microsoft's documented worked example: issued 2008-04-01, matures 2008-06-15, 10% coupon on 1000 par, Actual/365 basis
cases.expected_note: Microsoft's page publishes this example's result as 20.54794521. Independently derived from the documented formula ACCRINTM = par * rate * A/D: serial 39539 = 2008-04-01 and 39614 = 2008-06-15, so on basis 3 (Actual/365) A = 29 + 31 + 15 = 75 actual days and D = 365, giving 1000*0.1*75/365 = 20.547945205 -> 20.54794521 at 8 dp

cases.description: A coupon rate of zero is outside the documented domain
cases.expected_note: Excel documents: "If rate <= 0 or if par <= 0, ACCRINTM returns the #NUM! error value."

cases.description: Basis 5 is above the documented 0-4 range
cases.expected_note: Excel documents: "If basis < 0 or if basis > 4, ACCRINTM returns the #NUM! error value." The documented basis table stops at 4 (European 30/360)

cases.description: Issue date later than the maturity date (arguments swapped)
cases.expected_note: Excel documents: "If issue >= settlement, ACCRINTM returns the #NUM! error value."
